g.text: PDM-AI — Predictive Maintenance for Industrial Machinery
Built an AI system to predict failure of industrial machine parts in advance,
addressing multi-week replacement-part delivery delays.
Designed a futuristic dashboard for live sensor readings and an AI chatbot for maintenance.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · REACT
AI Architect — Blueprint Maker
Developed an AI tool that auto-generates architectural blueprints from user-entered measurements.
Translates raw plot dimensions into structured, ready-to-use building layouts, reducing manual effort.
PYTHON · GENERATIVE AI · COMPUTER VISION
AI Startup Evaluation Engine
AI-powered platform helping startups assess and improve cost, roadmap, and structure.
Designed a 'Startup DNA' module to profile a startup's core strengths and gaps for founders.
PYTHON · NLP · NEXTJS
Python-Driven Alert Automation & Threat Intel
Developed Python automation scripts to parse large volumes of JSON security logs.
Extracted critical indicators of compromise (IoCs) to streamline the alert triage process.
Integrated threat intelligence APIs like VirusTotal to automatically verify reputation of IPs.
PYTHON · AUTOMATION · THREAT INTEL · API
Network Traffic & Phishing Analysis
Captured and analyzed raw network traffic using Wireshark to establish behavioral baselines.
Identified anomalies such as non-standard ports or potential data exfiltration.
Investigated malicious email headers and built custom detection rules for social engineering tactics.
WIRESHARK · NETWORK ANALYSIS · PHISHING DETECTION
Secure Network Architecture & Tor Hidden Service Simulation
Configured and deployed a localized Tor hidden service within a Kali Linux virtual machine.
Analyzed secure routing protocols, network traffic obfuscation, and defensive mechanics.
KALI LINUX · TOR · VIRTUALIZATION · SECURITY PROTOCOLS
